global_boundaries: Passing one layer never implies that a later layer passed.
Provider credentials and commercial solver licenses are never stored in the repository.
Layer A reads no environment-variable values and makes no model, API, solver, native-evaluator or VM call.
The public v1.0.0 repository and integrity/audit package are verified; endpoint rescoring from restricted inputs remains a separate controlled-review contract.
No archival DOI is claimed until an external archival deposit is verified.

layers.boundary: Layer A is an integrity/audit reconstruction. It does not rerun provider inference, benchmark solvers, native evaluators, or independently rescore restricted benchmark endpoints from evaluator-only answers; those require the separately declared controlled-review path.
layers.claim: The public v1.0.0 integrity/audit package, current content-addressed library identity, aggregate claim arithmetic and body-free direct-versus-mixed identities are reproducible after retrieving the exact public repository and pinned submodule.
expanded_commands: python3 -m unittest tests.test_content_addressed_manifests tests.test_current_library_manifests tests.test_current_library_reconstruction tests.test_release_evidence_reconstruction tests.test_atomic_publisher tests.test_reconstruction_publishers tests.test_clean_clone_layer_a tests.test_verified_skill_library tests.test_audit_mixed_skill_confirmation tests.test_mixed_skill_execution

remote_dependency.transport: Git HTTPS forced to HTTP/1.1 for this command only

layers.boundary: The smoke check reads no benchmark instance, private evaluator answer, request or response body. It makes no provider, external solver, native evaluator or VM call. Exact package versions are pinned, but distributable wheel hashes and rights-safe release history remain separate Layer G11 work.
layers.claim: The exact offline Python/package environment passes isolated synthetic checks for every declared analysis dependency and the project statistical, schema and grouping paths.

layers.boundary: This is a machine-local external-license smoke test. It is not credential-free, does not read or score the benchmark dataset, and does not establish that another machine has Gurobi or a valid license. Layer A remains the credential-free public evidence layer.
layers.claim: The pinned local binary, fixed runtime limits, pinned OR-Debug submodule and both solver-facing code paths pass on synthetic instances.
layers.credentials: commercial solver license external; never stored or inspected by verifier
synthetic_checks: declarative mixed-integer solve with independent primal recheck

layers.boundary: This preflight makes zero API calls and does not serialize or replay private experiment envelopes, establish account authorization or future provider behavior. Live replay requires separately held private protocol material, an account, a credential and author authorization; public evidence reconstruction does not.
layers.claim: The public body-free transport surface binds the exact local CA dependency, TLS construction, endpoint, model and concurrency without importing private request construction.
layers.credential_source: external private profile only; never stored in repository
layers.offline_replay: use frozen public projections and ledgers; do not resend requests
layers.release_surface: endpoint, model, concurrency, CA identity and TLS construction only; private request-envelope construction excluded
layers.transport: body-free public TLS/endpoint preflight using standard-library ssl plus certifi 2026.7.22

layers.boundary: Existing collision and final-size visual QA transfer only because the regenerated PNG/TIFF pixels are byte-identical. This does not close solver, provider, license, rights or history-safe release layers.
layers.claim: Both main figures rebuild in a fresh temporary tree with passing repository-local alignment and PDF font-floor checks; Figure 1 now depicts the implemented canonical manifest as a retrospective artifact measurement. PNG/TIFF are byte-identical and PDF/SVG are byte-identical after only declared nonsemantic canonicalization.

purpose: Separate credential-free evidence reconstruction from analysis, solver/native, provider and figure dependencies so each reproducibility claim names the environment it actually requires.
